title: Cloudflare R2: bucket and key
question: The asset sync tool is built and tested. It needs a bucket and a key that only you can create (about 5 minutes). Press Send when it's done.

options.label: Done, the four values are in .env
options.note: 1. Cloudflare dashboard, R2 (it asks for a payment method once): create bucket amakawa-assets, location Automatic, public access off. 2. R2, Manage API tokens: Object Read & Write, 'Apply to specific buckets only' = amakawa-assets, no expiry. The page then shows a Token value, an Access Key ID, a Secret Access Key and an S3 endpoint. Copy the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key (shown once). The Token value isn't needed: our tool talks to R2 through its S3 interface. The Account ID is on the R2 overview, and is also the part before .r2.cloudflarestorage.com in the endpoint. 3. In .env: R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET=amakawa-assets. 4. Optional check: python3 tools/assets/sync.py status --remote should end with 'R2: 0 blobs'.

decision: Keys in .env; sync.py status --remote connects (R2: 0 blobs), 2026-09-29
